q: Changing /invoices/123 to /invoices/124 shows another user's invoice. This is …
why: Every object access must check ownership.

q: Copying all request fields into the user record, so a user sets is_admin=true, is …
why: Allow-list the fields a client may set.

q: Hiding a button in the UI is enough authorisation.
why: Myth. The server must check every request; the UI is only convenience.
